data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 173.051m. During 2017 the Syndicate recorded favourable prior-year reserve movements (gross) totalling GBP 77.022m (a release of ~44.5% of opening gross reserves), primarily driven by favourable claims development predominantly on Property and to a lesser extent Aviation. The calendar year was heavily impacted by 2017 natural catastrophes (Harvey, Irma, Maria) which affected the current accident year, while prior years experienced reserve releases.
raw_causal_phrases: There have been positive reserve movements in the year, particularly on the 2014 and prior years of account, and to a lesser extent 2015.
These have mostly been on Property reserves but also on Aviation, amounting to GBP 10.7m.
The technical provisions set at 31 December 2016 were all used in the calendar year, and the Syndicate had to strengthen reserves on the prior year for the 2016 year of account.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column (explicit, GBP 000 -> converted to millions). Prior year development taken from Technical Provisions note 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross) = (GBP 77,022k) = release of GBP 77.022m. Narrative elsewhere quotes a net favourable movement of GBP 10.7m (after reinsurance) - both figures reported in document; the prior_year_development_gbp_m field uses the GROSS technical-provisions figure as required. Claims development triangle is present and used as corroborating source. All monetary amounts reported in native GBP. Some narrative numbers are net of reinsurance; where only net figures were present they were not used for gross prior year movement.
